quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: revenue RMB 2,053,298,171.74, up 48.75% from RMB 1,380,378,763.53, which the company attributes to new series such as darkfield nano-pattern wafer defect inspection and upgraded series such as its 4th-gen unpatterned wafer defect inspection and 3rd-gen overlay metrology tools, driving continued growth in order scale and revenue. Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 58,652,552.17, a turnaround from a RMB -11,525,122.93 loss, on scale effects as R&D grew but fell as a share of revenue; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -122,551,679.83. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 294,158,044.69, Q2 RMB 408,015,885.30, Q3 RMB 499,550,505.31, Q4 RMB 851,573,736.44 (Q4 net profit RMB 73,351,041.73). Operating cash flow RMB -862,171,235.18 as raw-material purchases and R&D rose with business scale; inventory RMB 2,698,756,600.21 (+54.50%) on higher raw-material purchases, production and shipped goods.

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Portfolio at end-2025 (annual report): in 2025 the company formally launched several new products based on e-beam and X-ray technology alongside its optical tools, giving thirteen equipment series and three software lines for advanced logic, advanced memory and HBM 2.5D/3D packaging customers. Nine series are in volume production on leading domestic customers' lines; brightfield nano-pattern wafer defect inspection, wafer flatness metrology and TSV copper-fill void metrology tools have shipped in batches to multiple leading domestic customers for line process validation (the flatness tool to a leading HBM customer); the high-aspect-ratio etch-structure metrology tool passed line validation at a leading domestic memory customer; the e-beam CD metrology prototype is in customer sample validation. The company says its patterned wafer inspection and 3D topography tools hold the vast majority of the domestic wafer-level advanced-packaging market. Its customers span logic, memory, power, MEMS, compound semiconductors (SiC, GaN, GaAs), advanced packaging, silicon wafer makers and etch / deposition / CMP equipment makers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (2025 annual report): R&D investment RMB 656,111,506.76, up 31.76%, 31.95% of revenue (36.07% in 2024), all expensed; 656 R&D staff, 43.82% of employees; 789 patents held, 314 of them invention patents. Projects in industrialisation validation include brightfield nano-pattern wafer defect inspection (planned total RMB 64,657.53 ten-thousand, RMB 38,047.73 ten-thousand invested to date), unpatterned and darkfield nano-pattern inspection, overlay, film-thickness, 3D topography, high-aspect-ratio etch-structure metrology and e-beam CD metrology; total planned project investment RMB 220,646.64 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Production bases and construction (2025 annual report): the company has three production bases in Shenzhen, Shanghai and Guangzhou; fixed assets rose 253.10% to RMB 733,418,763.74, mainly as the self-built Guangzhou plant was transferred to fixed assets and equipment grew. Major construction in progress: the high-end semiconductor quality-control equipment industrialisation project building (budget RMB 47,083.90 ten-thousand, cumulative input 83.39% of budget, RMB 36,776.58 ten-thousand transferred to fixed assets in 2025); the headquarters base and R&D center upgrade building (budget RMB 39,116.60 ten-thousand, 20.13%); the Shanghai high-end semiconductor quality-control equipment industrialisation project (budget RMB 65,501.63 ten-thousand, 14.96%); the Shanghai R&D and test center (budget RMB 22,901.09 ten-thousand, 26.48%). Raised-fund projects: Shanghai R&D test and industrialisation project (planned RMB 116,076.74 ten-thousand, 13.45% invested), headquarters base and R&D center upgrade (RMB 62,000.00 ten-thousand, 10.64%), the IPO industrialisation project (RMB 61,677.70 ten-thousand, 64.78%); no completion dates are stated. The company says these projects will significantly raise its inspection and metrology R&D and production capacity.
